<div class="card-body">
'''Echo Base Trooper''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">エコー基地兵員</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ホス以外の位置では戦闘力－１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Echo-Base-Trooper-SWCA-100679.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">エコー基地の防衛部隊は全員、熟練の戦士たちだ。ジェス・アラシェインのような兵員は、寒冷地で帝国軍の戦法に対抗できるように訓練を受けている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Echo Base Trooper.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Power minus 1 at locations outside Hoth.

'''Lore:'''
Echo Base’s defense force is made up of veteran warriors. Troopers such as Jess Allashane train to counter Imperial tactics in cold environments.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses location for the power penalty where the English uses site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Base Trooper]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
